title: Any wallet can self-assign as super_admin for arbitrary mint
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  An arbitrary signer is accepted as super_admin at initialize_extra_account_metas and does not verify any relationship between that signer and the target mint:  ``` #[account(init, seeds = [TRANSFER_HOOK_STATE_SEED.as_bytes(), mint.key().as_ref()], ...)] pub transfer_hook_state: Account<'info, TransferHookState>, ```  There is no constraint on mint.mint_authority or mint.freeze_authority.
